trajectory_summary: This call stayed under the customer's control from the first word to the last — he vetted the rep's legitimacy at least four separate times, steered the conversation toward his own priorities (sustainability, reliability, ability to pay), and exited the call still asking where the rep was located. The rep answered questions honestly and ran the interest question and credit qualifier, but never got a live bill, never locked a callback time, and ended the call with a pure goodbye rather than a booked next step.
outcome_dispute: The transcript shows no appointment set, no date/time exchanged, and no confirmed callback window — the rep's only forward commitment is 'I'll send a message to you... right after this call.' This is a text-follow-up promise, not a booked or tentative appointment, so any v1 tag suggesting a set appointment should be corrected to no_appointment or callback (unlocked).
